Bhide dresses up as the "modern magician" AI, demonstrating its growing influence on daily life, work, and the future. He shows 1960s retro AI-styled looks of the society members and highlights both the benefits and risks of technology.
Step into Jethalal’s world with Gada Electronics! Manage the shop, tackle quirky customers, and experience nonstop TMKOC-style fun.
Are you ready for the challenge?
